chunks: He asked him about Ibrāhīm, the son of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله, whether, if he had remained alive, he would have been a truthful prophet. He said: “If he had remained alive, he would have been upon the path of his father, may the blessings of Allah be upon him.”

key_terms.أَبِيهِ: his father, referring to the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.إِبْرَاهِيمَ: Ibrāhīm, the son of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله
key_terms.رَسُولِ اللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah, Prophet Muḥammad صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.صِدِّيقًا: utterly truthful and affirming the truth

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام say about Ibrāhīm ibn Rasūl Allāh صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم if he had lived?
ai.summary: This report asks about the status of Ibrāhīm, the son of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, had he lived. The reply states that he would have been upon the path of his father, indicating continuity with the prophetic way and highlighting the noble station associated with the Prophet’s household.
